critical_code_review_comments: Portfolio.jsx couples PROJECTS array indices with i18n array order — safe today but a mismatch in one language would silently break; consider keying by id.
Google Maps iframe uses non-API embed (google.com/maps?output=embed) which works but is unofficial; consider using the Google Maps Embed API with a key for reliability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 requested changes verified working on the preview URL. Preloader dismisses after ~2.2s so preloader-logo cannot be queried after that; consider inspecting during preload if re-testing.
